chunks.rationale: Divergence pairing is unchanged: tool steps by number, sibling forks first. This itinerary is the merge-resolution note for #531, not Ask mode's leftover itinerary from #532.
risks: Permission allow/deny is still not persisted on ToolCallInfo, so decision is only ok/error/pending.
comparePeers is still memo'd on rosterKey (id:status).
First divergence is the first paired tool step whose type/name/input/output/decision differs. Two models that take the same tools with different prose will report no divergence.
A still-running shorter side does not count extra steps on the other side as a split.
No live Electron click-through after this merge.
